provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled scientific study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

history_definition: Two characters indicate whether an individual was detected at each subsequent occasion. The initial resident cohort is known independently. Fractional/proportional counts here are exact controlled model expectations, not a finite realized sample likelihood fit.
state_model: Between each occasion a live resident survives with unknown S,then permanently leaves the observation region with conditional probability e. Only live residents can be detected; those residents are independently detected with known p at each occasion. A permanent emigrant never returns or produces an encounter, just like a dead individual. S and e are constant over both intervals,independent across individuals,0<=S,e<=1. Apparent resident survival is phi=S*(1-e).
target: Use all supplied expected histories to check the common phi and report sharp marginal feasible intervals for S and e over the full compatible parameter set. True survival.9is a proposed value to test,not an external calibration.
scope: Apparent survival versus permanent emigration nonidentifiability; no mortality mechanism or live-individual tracking procedure is inferred.
